title: Pins
subtitle: Freeze a piece in front of a bigger one

steps.say: A pin freezes a piece. Black's knight on c6 can't move, because then your bishop would be attacking the king.
When the piece behind is the king, moving is against the rules. When it's the queen or a rook, moving is allowed, but it costs them.
Here Black's queen went to c6. Look at the diagonal from the queen to the king.

task.prompt: Pin the queen to the king and win her.
task.hint: Your bishop can attack the queen from b5, and your knight guards that square.
task.success: Pinned! The queen can't step away without exposing the king.

steps.say: The best Black can do is give the queen for your bishop.
Look for their pieces lined up with their king or queen. If you can attack the front one, you might have a pin.
